meta.title: Remove a T&C with the cross next to it

plan.title: Remove a T&C with the cross

steps.note: Open the buyer create screen containing the Terms & Conditions control.
Provide the required create-screen title before interacting with the form.

args.goal: open the Terms & Conditions panel, add at least two terms, click the cross next to one term, click Done, reopen the panel, and verify that the removed term is absent while the remaining term(s) are still listed

steps.note: Perform the cross-removal and Done workflow and inspect the reopened panel, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Assert the known Terms & Conditions control is present after the interaction.
